tier_1_bootstrap.title: Smart Web Installer (Recommended)
tier_1_bootstrap.behavior: Instant 3-second download. Installs the C++ vector client and GUI. On first launch, lets the researcher select custom Data Root (e.g. secondary SSD or D: drive) and streams model weights in the background with resume capability.

tier_2_airgapped.title: Air-Gapped Fieldwork Archive (Offline Sites)
tier_2_airgapped.behavior: All-in-one standalone package pre-bundled with 7B LLM weights and embeddings. Designed for remote archaeological excavations, desert field surveys, and laboratory air-gapped workstations without internet.

reasoning_llm.name: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M
reasoning_llm.role: Local archaeological claim contradiction detection, causal reasoning, thesis audit

embedding_engine.name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5.Q4_K_M
embedding_engine.role: Dense vector embedding for hybrid BM25 + cosine vector retrieval across field reports

minimum.cpu: x86_64 CPU with AVX2 instruction set (Intel Haswell 2013+ / AMD Zen 2017+)

recommended.cpu: Intel Core i7/i9 10th Gen+ or AMD Ryzen 7/9 5000+ (8+ cores)
recommended.gpu: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / 4060 or better (8 GB+ VRAM) for GPU offloading
